portability.contract: R2-06: this manifest carries no machine-specific absolute paths. sourceDir values are repo-root relative ('.' = the checkout containing scripts/perf/otel-workflows) or ${ENV} templates resolved by the runner at load time; resolved absolute paths, per-config SHAs and host facts are per-run metadata under out/otel-w964/workflow-audit-v3/run-meta/ (gitignored), never stored here. H0's pre-OTel checkout resolves from EXAM_OTEL_H0_SOURCE_DIR, defaulting to the sibling worktree ../exam-otel-h0, and pins its own commitSha lineage (cb1e614f) checked independently by gate item 5.

protocol.note: PROTOCOL-v4 (content hash, revision-log section excluded) governs arms/TELEMETRY_* semantics, workload quotas and gears, and the redefined interference criterion (in-segment absolute cap 8.0 AND external increment <= 1.5 over B_self 6.8; entry gate unchanged at 4.0). Owner adjudication 2026-11-15 (option c, proxy decision flagged for Owner review — PROTOCOL-v4 §1.3). Finalized parameters from pilot measurements: P_CONC=1, P_STEADY=300, P_QUOTA=2100 (equal-ratio scaled per-key, c4Rejects=190). Pre-freeze channel per PROTOCOL-v3 §9.1 / v4 §6: confirmation segments (round-0) precede freeze.json and formal sampling; Stage D-G remains separately authorized.

db.name: exam_e2e_w964
db.note: exam_e2e_w964 is in the testing.md §2.8 E2E worker-DB family (exam_e2e_w<N>) and on packages/db isFullResetTarget allowlist (destructiveDbNameGuard.ts). Slot 964 exceeds the E2E runner cap of 16 shards, so no collision with scripts/e2e/run.sh worker DBs is possible. APP_MODE=e2e + TEST_DATABASE_URL follow the E2E runtime precedent (scripts/e2e/run.sh:155-163). The dev `exam` database is never touched; the resolver output is verified with SELECT current_database() before any write.

seed.convergeNote: repo-owned reset+migrate+seed+demo+verify (scripts/e2e/run.sh:737 precedent); full reset guarded by isFullResetTarget
seed.extendNote: harness-owned deterministic direct-SQL extension: bench users/candidates/teachers/enrollments/exams; attempts are prepared post-start via HTTP (W02 data-prep mechanism, PROTOCOL §3)

prepPool.note: pools sized above quota (PROTOCOL §3.1) so ops never exhaust a pool mid-segment; attempts created via HTTP start (W02 prep) then backdated/disrupted by direct SQL (PROTOCOL §4.1 sanctions backdate/state prep by direct test-DB writes). closedAttemptsC4 = attempts frozen to terminal state during prep so the C4 'other rejects' quota (ATTEMPT_ALREADY_SUBMITTED) never races the C5 submit stream. benchCandidates=3000 covers all 2820 plan slots ONE-TO-ONE (B4 pool isolation, R2 round-0 evidence: post /start is resume semantics — per-candidate slots alias attempt rows across pools, so one pool's submit/freeze/backdate terminalized another pool's in-window slot; staleAttemptsW09 additionally stays future-deadline in standard prep, real auto-submit lives in the dedicated w09 command).

sharedEnv.note: HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT_MS pinned at 2h (> max round window 45min) so the heartbeat scanner can never race the workload pools: W06 disrupted attempts are seeded directly instead (deterministic), and no live attempt is disrupted mid-segment. Same frozen env for every config except the TELEMETRY_* arm keys (PROTOCOL §1 shared-config freeze). REDIS_URL intentionally unset (Redis mode off, per testing.md §2.6 local default; rate limiting is off under APP_MODE=e2e).

H0.description: v0.0.15 pre-OTel release baseline (PROTOCOL-v2 §1.1 H0): repo-default env. This SHA has no TELEMETRY_* settings keys (git show cb1e614f:apps/api/src/config/settings.ts | grep -c TELEMETRY_ -> 0), so no telemetry arm variables are set; env is intentionally empty. sharedEnv TELEMETRY_SERVICE_NAME still reaches the process but has no settings leaf at this SHA (inert). Workload restriction (PROTOCOL-v2 §6.6): the mixed C1-C7 quotas bind only to comparable workflows — W00-W06/W08-W12 comparable (range cb1e614f..1d689b4a touches no packages/contracts file, no DB migration, and all business-route/plugin diffs are span-wrapper instrumentation; oracle equivalence per PROTOCOL-v2 §6.6-3 still required before acceptance use); W13 is NOT_IMPLEMENTED at BOTH SHAs (identical absence, no ops in workload anyway); W14/W15 are telemetry-defined (no On-state exists at H0) and W07 has no record — all three excluded from H0 workload semantics.
H0.isolationNote: Dedicated test DB slot exam_e2e_w150: exam_e2e_w<N> family at BOTH SHAs (testing.md §2/§2.8 at cb1e614f), full-reset allowlisted at cb1e614f (packages/db/src/scripts/destructiveDbNameGuard.ts:120 /^exam_e2e_w\d+$/), slot 150 > E2E runner cap 16 (scripts/e2e/run.sh:82 at cb1e614f), disjoint from master harness exam_e2e_w964 / vitest exam_test* / dev exam. The runner honors per-config lineage: H0's own sourceDir/db drive converge cwd, TEST_DATABASE_URL, ensure/open verification and the argon2 require, while every other config falls back to the GLOBAL db.name/sourceDir (exam_e2e_w964 + master tree) — the manifest's H0 entry is therefore runnable as-is in mixed rounds; a pilot-scoped manifest copy is no longer required. Seed checksum continuity is likewise keyed per config (different seed lineages may legitimately checksum differently); round 0 is the pilot round and is excluded from aggregate statistics.
